title: The cure hidden inside ego’s illness
subtitle: For when self-importance keeps returning after every insight
description: Begin with Guru Angad’s unsparing diagnosis of ego as a chronic disease, then follow the cure that appears through grace and lived obedience to the Guru’s Shabad.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Ego is named as a deep disease, yet the shabad refuses despair because grace gives the cure through the Guru’s teaching practiced in the life.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When ego asks to be defended, name it as illness rather than identity and choose one action that obeys the Shabad instead of the self-image.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey keeps ego from becoming either a brand or a hopeless verdict by grounding the whole movement in Guru Angad’s diagnosis and the grace-given medicine of practiced Shabad.
evidence.turn: The self is not improved by being admired; it is healed when grace makes the Guru’s word something the body actually does.
evidence.practicalImplication: Use the sequence to catch ego in a specific reaction, refuse to make it your name, and practice one humble obedience before explaining yourself.
